_master: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for Dave's Maine Café menu. Edit here → run `node build-menu.mjs` → the website menu (#eats/#bar in staging/index.html) regenerates. The SAME file is what Chipper pushes to Toast POS (names, descriptions, prices) once Dave grants Toast write access, so pricing + copy stay in sync across web + POS from one place. Transcribed from Dave's CURRENT printed food + beverage pages (Lobster Roll-Palooza / '10 Years Strong') on 2026-07-14. Photos archived in dave-cafe-chipper/reference/menus/.

taglines: Fresh. Never frozen. Picked daily. Good food. Good people. Maine made.

_rules: Numbering rules for the master: (1) Bad Decisions shot+beer combos are numbered as EXITS starting at 1. (2) Draft Highway taps are numbered #9–#24 (the draft board starts at 9). Keep these when editing.
